# HTML Instructions
applyTo: "**/*.html"

## HTML Best Practices
- Always include DOCTYPE html declaration
- Use semantic HTML5 elements (header, main, section, article, nav, aside, footer)
- Include proper meta tags (charset, viewport)
- Use meaningful alt text for images
- Ensure proper heading hierarchy (h1, h2, h3, etc.)

## Accessibility
- Include proper ARIA labels when needed
- Ensure good color contrast
- Use semantic markup for better screen reader support
- Include focus indicators for interactive elements

## Structure
- Keep HTML clean and well-indented
- Use lowercase for all HTML tags and attributes
- Quote all attribute values
- Close all HTML tags properly

## Forms
- Always include labels for form inputs
- Use appropriate input types (email, tel, url, etc.)
- Include placeholder text in Portuguese when helpful
- Add proper validation attributes (required, pattern, etc.)

## Comments
- Use Portuguese for HTML comments
- Comment complex sections or layout structures
